main_text.head: INSTITUTIONUM METAPHYSICARUM, Tractatus Primus.
Introitus.
main_text.p: INstitutiones Metaphysicas triplici ab-solvam tractatu, Proœmiali, Subjectivo & Consequente; Quorum primus Præcognita; secundus Metaphysicæ subjectum, eôque pertinentia; postremus, proxima exinde consequentia exhibet: Adeoque inter hos primus est quasi radix, secundus truncus, tertius fructus.

2. Tractatus Proœmialis tribus constabit sectionibus; Quarum prima Naturam Philosophiæ in genere: secunda Naturam Metaphysicæ in specie: tertia prærequisita ad notitiam Entis in genere explicat. Sit igitur

page.notes: Opening initial "I" is a large woodcut-style letter joined to "Nstitutiones" (transcribed as printed: "INstitutiones"). Ornament band at top is not text. Page number not printed. Some words in the first paragraph are uncertain due to scan quality; the paragraph-initial "I." is a section number.
